name: Jordan Ellis
title: Data Engineer
summary: Data engineer with 4 years of experience building reliable ETL pipelines and analytics infrastructure. Comfortable owning a data platform end to end, from ingestion through to the dashboards analysts actually use.

bullets: Own ingestion pipelines processing roughly 500GB/day across 12 upstream sources, orchestrated with Airflow.
Migrated a batch reporting pipeline to an incremental model, cutting nightly runtime from 4 hours to 45 minutes.
Built a data quality framework (schema checks, freshness alerts) that catches upstream breakages before analysts see them.
Built and maintained dbt models powering weekly sales and inventory dashboards for 6 regional teams.
Wrote a reusable Python framework for validating CSV vendor feeds before they entered the warehouse.

projects.name: Open-source CSV Schema Validator
bullets: Small Python library that validates CSV files against a declared schema before ingestion.
Used internally in a demo pipeline; published as an example project.

projects.name: Streaming Clickstream Demo
bullets: Kafka + Spark Structured Streaming pipeline that aggregates simulated clickstream events into rolling window metrics.
Built as a learning project to explore streaming vs. batch tradeoffs.

certifications: AWS Certified Data Analytics - Specialty (demo entry)
